name: Grand Melee
review:
Grand Melee is a comic royal battle on 6 reels with 1,193 connecting ways. Sticky respins unlock game area expansion, symbol expansion and symbol upgrades.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 5,000x cap and a 96.17% RTP.

The sticky respins are where Grand Melee comes alive: every respin can expand the grid, enlarge symbols or upgrade them, so a modest start can snowball. The comedic medieval art matches the chaos.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
